motion_and_effects.micro_interactions: Soft lift -translate-y-1, border color shift to #155C45 on card hover, discreet solar gold dot pulse

testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, forms, step buttons, links, and cards MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-eligibility-btn', data-testid='eligibility-step-1-next', data-testid='aid-card-maprimerenov')

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always maintain light ivory (#FAFAF7) and clean white backgrounds. Never use heavy dark gradients or neon modern colors.
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings. Always use 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) for headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text.
Include the private editorial platform disclaimer in header, hero subtext, and footer to reinforce trust without impersonating government services.
Ensure every form and button contains explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
Smooth motion transitions using framer-motion and lenis are required across all interactive components.
